subject: Stargrove: unexpected 429s — plan for quota config sanitization
messages:
From: Lena Morales <lena@stargrove.com>
To: jasmine.liu@redwood.ai, neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 09 Aug 2027 14:12:00 +0000
Subject: Spike of 429s in production after quota change

Hi Jasmine / Neha,

We started seeing an uptick of 429 responses across several endpoints (~11:35 UTC) right after we applied the new token-budget mapping you recommended last week. This is hitting our user-facing inference path and causing errors in the mobile app. Attached are a short log extract and the snapshot of our tenant config.

Short summary:
- Error rate: ~7% 429s for generate endpoint between 11:35–12:10 UTC.
- Observed pattern: bursts coincide with longer sequences (>1200 tokens) and a few parallel jobs.

Can you treat this as urgent? We need an immediate mitigation plan (temporary override / routing) and a longer-term fix to avoid recurrence. We can jump on a call in the next 30 minutes.

Attachments: stargrove-config-snapshot-20270809.json, config-audit.log

Thanks,
Lena Morales
Head of Ops, Stargrove Health
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Morales <lena@stargrove.com>
Cc: neha.kapoor@redwood.ai, markus.klein@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 09 Aug 2027 14:20:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Spike of 429s in production after quota change

Lena — thanks for the flag and the logs, this is high priority. I can spin up a temporary routing override and push a fast config rollback if needed. Before I act: two quick asks so we avoid an overly blunt rollback:

1) Can you confirm which route IDs are exhibiting the 429s? (route ids or example request ids from the logs)
2) Are session tokens or shared API keys involved (i.e., are these requests tied to a single integration consumer)?

Immediate plan (if you don't hear back from us in 15m, we will):
- Apply a conservative temporary ratecap increase for the affected tenant for the next 60 minutes.
- Deploy a small routing bypass to send longer sequences to a warm pool we control (lower queuing).

I've looped in Markus from Infra to do the config audit in parallel. He'll validate the quota mapping rules and help craft the sanitization steps so the same mapping doesn't re-introduce uneven token accounting.

If you want immediate rollback instead, say so and I will revert the mapping.

-Jasmine
Jasmine Liu
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>, neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
Cc: Lena Morales <lena@stargrove.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Aug 2027 14:35:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Spike of 429s in production after quota change

Quick update from Infra side: initial telemetry shows that the quota translation layer applied an additive per-call overhead for long-sequence requests during the recent mapping rollout; that pushed several concurrent long-running requests over the translated budget windows. This is a config translation bug — not a model-side thrift.

Proposed immediate actions (we prepared a short playbook):
- Apply tenant-level temporary cap increment +2x for the next 90 minutes (done-attempt pending approval).
- Enable bypass routing for sequences >1k tokens to the dedicated warm pool (no model change).
- Run a config sanitization script to detect and fix additive-overhead rules (script attached as sanitized-playbook).

Longer-term:
- We'll add a unit test to the quota translation pipeline that simulates long-sequence concurrency.
- Postmortem follow-up with a regression test gate before any mapping rollouts.

I attached the first draft of the sanitization playbook and the audit log. If Lena approves, we'll execute the temporary cap bump now and confirm recovery.

Attachments: sanitization-playbook-v1.pdf, config-audit.log

-Markus
Markus Klein
Director, Infrastructure Reliability, Redwood Inference
From: Lena Morales <lena@stargrove.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 09 Aug 2027 14:48:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Spike of 429s in production after quota change

Thanks — please proceed with the temporary +2x cap increment and enable the routing bypass. We will monitor. Also, our finance team will want a credit note for the window where customer requests failed. Can you confirm the window you'll apply for credit consideration?

For route ids: generate-api-v1 (route:g-gen-1), batch-infer (route:b-infer-03). The failures include requests from two different API keys (one mobile key, one partner key).

Call in 10 minutes to sync if you prefer — otherwise carry on.

Lena 
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Morales <lena@stargrove.com>
Cc: neha.kapoor@redwood.ai, markus.klein@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2027 09:30:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Spike of 429s in production after quota change — sanitization playbook and next steps

Hi Lena — following up with the agreed remediation summary and next steps so we have a single source of truth. Sorry for the delay in documenting — we wanted to validate the audit results before sending.

Incident recap: on 2027-08-09 the quota translation pipeline introduced an additive overhead rule for long-sequence requests during a mapping rollout, which made several requests exceed tenant budgets and produce unexpected 429s for generate-api-v1 and batch-infer.

What we executed (08/09, immediate):
- Temporary tenant cap increment (+2x) applied at 14:38 UTC — reduced 429s to baseline within 6 minutes.
- Routing bypass for sequences >1k tokens enabled at 14:45 UTC and remained until we completed the sanitization.
- Config audit run and sanitized mapping deployed at 17:20 UTC.

What we are delivering now (attachments & scheduled items):
- sanitization-playbook-v1.pdf — step-by-step script we executed and the checks to run before future rollouts.
- config-audit.log and stargrove-config-snapshot-20270809.json for your records.
- Postmortem session scheduled: 2027-08-18 15:00 UTC (invite sent to your ops calendar).
- Credit window: we will initiate a credit review for 14:35–15:00 UTC on 2027-08-09; Neha will own communication with billing and confirm estimate by 2027-08-17.

Immediate owner assignments:
- Action: billing credit evaluation — NEHA KAPOOR (neha.kapoor@redwood.ai)
- Action: permanent guardrails for quota translation + unit tests — MARKUS KLEIN (markus.klein@redwood.ai)
- Action: confirm recovery and final sign-off — JASMINE LIU (jasmine.liu@redwood.ai)

If that plan looks right, we'll close the incident thread and share the finalized playbook after incorporating any feedback from your ops team. Appreciate your patience and the quick signal to catch this early.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
[attachment stubs: sanitization-playbook-v1.pdf, stargrove-config-snapshot-20270809.json, config-audit.log]
